Oracle Corporation $ORCL Position Lifted by Dividend Assets Capital LLC

Dividend Assets Capital LLC raised its holdings in shares of Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL – Free Report) by 24.4% during the first quarter, HoldingsChannel reports. The institutional investor owned 90,802 shares of the enterprise software provider’s stock after acquiring an additional 17,837 shares
